score_notes.T2: Covers the source pages in a sensible order: concepts, HTTP path, composition, local loop, FastAPI, streaming and cancellation, framework tutorials, config files, production and comparison. Each section rests on the cited docs. Minor: the scikit-learn and TensorFlow tutorial code (L804-955) takes about 150 lines for little new Serve content.
score_notes.T3: Explains what happens at runtime: bind returns a DeploymentNode, bound arguments become handles, DeploymentResponse is a future and chaining resolves it, the await-point cancellation semantics, sync-generator blocking, and cloudpickle versus the factory pattern. It closes with when to choose Ray Serve and its gaps. Deductions: no architecture internals (no ServeController, proxy actor or replica scheduling; 'controller' never appears), autoscaling and batching only named (L23, L133), and observability is three generic paragraphs (L1120-1126). All 9 sources are official docs.ray.io pages, with no design doc or non-official write-up.
